newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains quiet as futures rally.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains quiet as futures rally.

text.p: A currency based rally on the UK grain futures subdued trading in physicals on Wednesday.
"Sellers ran away when they saw the futures rally while buyers are saying we know the grain is there but we are not interested until the New Year," said a trader.
On the fob market feed wheat traded at 100.50 stg for Apr/Jun ex-east coast ports with sellers last reported at 101.50 stg, two stg up from Tuesday.
Delivered traded levels were around two stg above Tuesday's with feed wheat in East Anglia fetching 94.50 to 95 stg for Dec and 97 stg for Jan. New crop Oct/Dec traded at 97.50 stg.
In the Avon range 95.50 stg was paid for Dec and 98 stg for Jan/Mar.
Feed barley in East Anglia was fetching 97 stg for Dec amd 99 stg in the New Year.
No business was reported for milling wheat and traders said the remainder of the market tonnages were low.
